criteria.description: General category maximum age is 26 years and minimum is 18, both as on August 1 2026.
criteria.raw_quote: 4.3.  Maximum Age Limit (Maximum Age as on August 1, 2026) - (Refer Table -5) i. General category - 26 years, ... vii. The minimum age limit for all the applicants is 18 years as on August 1, 2026.
criteria.reason: Born 2000-08-01, GENERAL, not PwD. Exact 26.0 years on 2026-08-01; inclusive boundary: 26 <= 26 -> MET.

criteria.description: B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc.(Engg)/5-yr Integrated M.Tech with 60% aggregate OR 6.0 CGPA in one of the eight engineering disciplines; CSE qualifies.
criteria.raw_quote: i. B.E. / B.Tech./ B.Sc. (Engineering) / 5-year Integrated M. Tech.  with a minimum of 60%* aggregate marks (or minimum of 6.0 CGPA on a scale of 10 or equivalent) in one of the above mentioned eight engineering disciplines mentioned in Table-1a.
criteria.reason: B.Tech CSE 68% >= 60%, CGPA 7.2 >= 6.0, discipline CSE in allowed list -> MET (either arm).

criteria.description: GATE-2024/2025/2026 score in the same GATE paper as the qualifying degree discipline.
criteria.raw_quote: Applicants, who meets above mentioned educational criteria and also willing to be considered on the basis of a GATE score must have a valid GATE-2024 / GATE-2025 /GATE-2026 score in the same GATE paper/subject as the qualifying degree discipline.
criteria.reason: GATE-2025 CS; 2025 in valid years and paper CS matches qualifying degree discipline (CSE) -> MET. GATE route is a screening option in parallel to online exam; either way this candidate satisfies it.

criteria.description: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
criteria.raw_quote: 4.4.  Nationality: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
